BREAKING: China’s crude oil imports dropped -41% YoY in June, to 29 million tons or 7 million barrels per day, the lowest in 10 years.

MoM, oil imports fell by -4 million tons, or -12%, to the weakest level in 8 years.

Import volumes have now declined -26 million tons, or -47%,

items.headline: Bloomberg News retracted a story about the Singapore property market originally published on Dec. 12, 2024 to comply with a court order after a Singapore judge found that the article was defamatory of two senior government ministers. Bloomberg contested the accusation in court.
